law: Single authority for FALCON-visible field names and types per docs/contracts/FALCON-FIELD-REGISTRY.md. No producer may invent an unregistered field or a synonym for an already-registered concept.

fields.name: falcon_event_id
fields.description: Globally unique, immutable evidence identity. Stable across producer retry of the same logical evidence emission. NEVER derived solely from payload content — see payload_hash.

fields.name: envelope_version
fields.description: Version of the universal FalconEvent envelope contract itself.

fields.name: payload_schema_version
fields.description: Version of the registered typed payload schema named by evidence_family/evidence_type.

fields.name: producer_system_id
fields.description: Registered machine system identity of the publishing producer. Authoritative list: registry/system_component_registry.v1.json.

fields.name: producer_component_id
fields.description: Registered stable component identity of the publishing producer (system.component_name shape). Never a hostname, container name or Graylog stream/index/message id.

fields.name: producer_instance_id
fields.description: Optional runtime instance identity, separate from the stable component identity (e.g. which replica emitted this event).

fields.name: evidence_family
fields.description: Registered event family. Authoritative list: registry/event_family_registry.v1.json.

fields.name: evidence_type
fields.description: Registered subtype within evidence_family. Exact subtypes are registered per-family (illustrative/placeholder in PID-01 since no live producers exist yet).

fields.name: evidence_class
fields.description: Epistemic class of this evidence, independent of which system produced it.

fields.name: produced_at_utc
fields.description: UTC instant the producer created this evidence record. Canonical, timezone-aware, UTC-only (Z or +00:00) — naive/local timestamps are rejected.

fields.name: occurred_at_utc
fields.description: UTC instant of the real-world occurrence this evidence describes, where applicable.

fields.name: observed_at_utc
fields.description: UTC instant the producer observed the underlying fact.

fields.name: available_at_utc
fields.description: UTC instant this evidence first became usable by the producer's own decision logic. Participates in causal eligibility; a retrospective measurement must never appear as contemporaneously knowable.

fields.name: effective_from_utc
fields.description: UTC instant a state/decision becomes effective.

fields.name: effective_until_utc
fields.description: UTC instant a state/decision expires or ends.

fields.name: falcon_ingested_at_utc
fields.description: FALCON-owned ingestion UTC. Never producer-supplied as authority; a producer submitting this field is not itself proof of ingestion — FALCON assigns it. Fixtures in this PID represent already-accepted evidence (there is no live ingress yet), so this is populated as an ordinary recorded fact here, not as a simulation of a running ingress service.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: Governed subject this evidence is about (instrument, component, market segment, etc., per family semantics).

fields.name: instrument_ids
fields.description: Canonical instrument(s) this evidence applies to. May be an empty array for evidence with no instrument applicability (e.g. health).

fields.name: correlation_id
fields.description: Logical investigation/thread grouping label. MAY be shared by many unrelated-but-associated events. Deliberately NOT the same shape as causation_id (not a pointer to one specific causing event) so the two cannot be used interchangeably.

fields.name: causation_id
fields.description: Immediate causal predecessor's falcon_event_id. MUST reference exactly one specific upstream event, never a broad grouping label — enforced by requiring the falcon_event_id UUID shape, which correlation_id's pattern deliberately does not accept.

fields.name: revision_id
fields.description: Family-specific revision identity.

fields.name: revision_sequence
fields.description: Ordered revision number where meaningful.

fields.name: supersedes_event_id
fields.description: falcon_event_id of the prior event this one supersedes. Append-preserving: the prior event remains searchable. Must never equal this event's own falcon_event_id.

fields.name: provenance_ref
fields.description: Governed producer provenance reference. Concrete structured shape chosen for PID-01 (contract only specifies 'string/object'): an object naming the upstream system and an upstream reference id, plus an optional human description. Not a free-form blob.

fields.name: quality_state
fields.description: Quality/freshness state using family-registered semantics (the vocabulary is defined per-family, not globally, per the field registry law 'registered family semantics').

fields.name: config_digest
fields.description: Truth-affecting configuration identity (hex digest).

fields.name: build_id
fields.description: Git SHA / build provenance of the producer.

fields.name: payload_hash
fields.description: Integrity hash of payload. Integrity data only — NOT event identity. Two events may legitimately share a payload_hash (e.g. identical heartbeats) while never sharing a falcon_event_id.

fields.name: retention_class
fields.description: FALCON registry value governing retention. PID-01 has no separate retention registry file, so the governed value-space is this field's registry enum.

fields.name: sensitivity_class
fields.description: FALCON registry value governing access/handling sensitivity. Governed the same way as retention_class (enum on this registry entry).

fields.name: payload
fields.description: The registered typed payload for evidence_family/evidence_type. Structurally generic at the envelope level; validated against the specific family schema by the validation pipeline.

fields.name: instrument_id
fields.description: Single canonical instrument this payload concerns (contrast with envelope instrument_ids, which is the broader applicability array).

fields.name: timeframe
fields.description: Chart/evaluation timeframe.

fields.name: health_status
fields.description: Health status of the reporting component.

fields.name: component_health_id
fields.description: Deterministic identity of this health observation.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Optional free-text operator detail. Never used to carry fabricated confidence/provenance.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Trade direction/action polarity.

fields.name: strategy_id
fields.description: HELIOS strategy identity.

fields.name: strategy_version
fields.description: HELIOS strategy version.

fields.name: semantic_fingerprint
fields.description: Semantic fingerprint of the strategy definition/parameterisation.

fields.name: parameter_set_id
fields.description: Identity of the exact parameter set used.

fields.name: input_snapshot_id
fields.description: Identity of the input data snapshot evaluated.

fields.name: input_snapshot_hash
fields.description: Integrity hash of the input data snapshot.

fields.name: evaluation_id
fields.description: Identity of a single HELIOS evaluation cycle.

fields.name: chain_id
fields.description: Identity of a HELIOS strategy chain, where applicable.

fields.name: local_trigger_id
fields.description: TRON-local durable trigger identity — authoritative for TRON-side dedupe.

fields.name: order_intent_id
fields.description: TRON order intent identity.

fields.name: broker_order_id
fields.description: Broker-assigned order identity.

fields.name: position_id
fields.description: TRON position identity.

fields.name: score_value
fields.description: Governed numeric score. Never a generic ungoverned 'confidence' — must be paired with score_definition_id.

fields.name: score_definition_id
fields.description: Identifies what score_value means. Must be a registered definition id (enum on this entry acts as the mini-registry for PID-01).

fields.name: signing_key_id
fields.description: Identity of the signing key. Contract-shaped placeholder only in PID-01 — no real cryptography (real signing is PID-08).

fields.name: signature
fields.description: Signature value. Contract-shaped placeholder only in PID-01 — no real cryptography (real signing is PID-08).

fields.name: fact_id
fields.description: HERMES deterministic identity of this specific market fact record.

fields.name: derivation_id
fields.description: HERMES derivation/configuration identity that produced this fact/state.

fields.name: series_id
fields.description: Canonical contract/series identity (e.g. front-month vs continuous).

fields.name: value_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative decimal-string value.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: value_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of value_decimal for search/aggregation only.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit of value_decimal (e.g. USD_per_troy_ounce).

fields.name: reference_price_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative decimal-string reference price, where applicable.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: reference_price_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of reference_price_decimal.

fields.name: state_id
fields.description: HERMES deterministic identity of this market-state record.

fields.name: state_value
fields.description: Family-governed state label.

fields.name: previous_state_value
fields.description: Prior state label, where a transition is being recorded.

fields.name: quality_transition_id
fields.description: HERMES deterministic identity of this quality transition record.

fields.name: previous_quality_state
fields.description: Freshness/quality state before the transition.

fields.name: new_quality_state
fields.description: Freshness/quality state after the transition.

fields.name: calendar_event_id
fields.description: ARES stable scheduled-event identity.

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Human-readable scheduled event name.

fields.name: scheduled_at_utc
fields.description: UTC instant the real-world calendar event is scheduled to occur.

fields.name: event_state
fields.description: Lifecycle state of the scheduled event.

fields.name: impact_level
fields.description: ARES-assessed impact level of the scheduled event.

fields.name: revision_of_calendar_event_id
fields.description: calendar_event_id this revision corrects/updates.

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: ARES market-session identity.

fields.name: market_id
fields.description: Market/segment this session state concerns.

fields.name: session_state
fields.description: Trading session lifecycle state.

fields.name: liquidity_subject_id
fields.description: Instrument or market segment this liquidity state concerns.

fields.name: liquidity_state
fields.description: ARES-assessed liquidity condition.

fields.name: breadth_measure_id
fields.description: Identity of the specific USD breadth measure (explicitly not DXY itself — DXY is a single index, breadth is a broader multi-pair construct).

fields.name: breadth_state
fields.description: ARES-assessed USD breadth condition.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: ARES upstream source identity whose quality is transitioning.

fields.name: ares_previous_quality_state
fields.description: ARES source quality state before the transition.

fields.name: ares_new_quality_state
fields.description: ARES source quality state after the transition.

fields.name: decision_id
fields.description: ARES publication decision identity.

fields.name: decision_type
fields.description: Whether this is a research or operational publication decision.

fields.name: decision_outcome
fields.description: Outcome of the publication decision.

fields.name: rationale_ref
fields.description: Reference/pointer to the rationale record. Never a fabricated free-text justification.

fields.name: state_before
fields.description: HELIOS evaluation state before this cycle.

fields.name: state_after
fields.description: HELIOS evaluation state after this cycle.

fields.name: conditions_satisfied
fields.description: List of named strategy conditions satisfied this cycle.

fields.name: conditions_failed
fields.description: List of named strategy conditions that failed this cycle (declines/near-misses must be explainable).

fields.name: chain_state
fields.description: Lifecycle state of a HELIOS strategy chain.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.description: HELIOS trigger identity.

fields.name: action_type
fields.description: Semantic action type of the trigger.

fields.name: trigger_at_utc
fields.description: UTC instant the trigger logically fired. Carried inside payload (not only the envelope) because it is part of the content that HELIOS signs.

fields.name: valid_from_utc
fields.description: UTC instant from which this trigger is valid for TRON discovery.

fields.name: valid_until_utc
fields.description: UTC instant after which this trigger is no longer valid for TRON discovery.

fields.name: stop_loss_decimal
fields.description: Semantic stop-loss level HELIOS defines for the strategy, if any. Not a broker order — TRON owns broker mechanics.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: stop_loss_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of stop_loss_decimal.

fields.name: take_profit_decimal
fields.description: Semantic take-profit level HELIOS defines for the strategy, if any.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: take_profit_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of take_profit_decimal.

fields.name: invalidation_decimal
fields.description: Semantic invalidation level for the trigger, if the strategy defines one.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: invalidation_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of invalidation_decimal.

fields.name: target_decimal
fields.description: Semantic target level for the trigger, if the strategy defines one.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: target_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of target_decimal.

fields.name: source_trigger_id
fields.description: The upstream HELIOS trigger_id this TRON observation refers to.

fields.name: signature_status
fields.description: Result of TRON's independent verification of the HELIOS trigger signature.

fields.name: admission_outcome
fields.description: TRON's admission decision outcome for an observed trigger.

fields.name: rejection_reason
fields.description: Terminal reason code when admission_outcome is REJECTED (or the trigger otherwise never executes).

fields.name: quantity_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative decimal-string intended order quantity.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: quantity_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of quantity_decimal.

fields.name: order_type
fields.description: Broker order type TRON selected.

fields.name: submitted_quantity_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative decimal-string quantity actually submitted to the broker.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: submitted_quantity_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of submitted_quantity_decimal.

fields.name: update_type
fields.description: Nature of this broker order lifecycle update.

fields.name: fill_id
fields.description: Broker fill identity.

fields.name: fill_price_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative decimal-string fill price.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: fill_price_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of fill_price_decimal.

fields.name: fill_quantity_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative decimal-string filled quantity.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: fill_quantity_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of fill_quantity_decimal.

fields.name: position_state_value
fields.description: TRON position lifecycle state.

fields.name: net_quantity_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative decimal-string net position quantity.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: net_quantity_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of net_quantity_decimal.

fields.name: protection_type
fields.description: Type of broker-native position protection.

fields.name: protection_level_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative decimal-string protection level.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: protection_level_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of protection_level_decimal.

fields.name: protection_status
fields.description: Current status of this protection instruction.

fields.name: exit_id
fields.description: TRON position exit identity.

fields.name: exit_reason
fields.description: Reason this position was exited.

fields.name: exit_price_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative decimal-string exit price.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: exit_price_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of exit_price_decimal.

fields.name: trade_outcome_id
fields.description: TRON trade outcome record identity.

fields.name: realised_pnl_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative signed decimal-string realised P&L.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: realised_pnl_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of realised_pnl_decimal.

fields.name: outcome_classification
fields.description: Coarse win/loss/breakeven classification of the trade outcome.

fields.name: slippage_decimal
fields.description: Authoritative signed decimal-string execution slippage.
fields.unit_precision: decimal string, unbounded precision, '.' separator, no thousands separator

fields.name: slippage_numeric
fields.description: Optional non-authoritative numeric mirror of slippage_decimal.

fields.name: latency_ms
fields.description: Measured execution latency in milliseconds.

fields.name: regime
fields.description: HERMES-computed market regime classification for a signal_state snapshot (BULL_TREND/BEAR_TREND/TRANSITION/LOW_VOLATILITY), derived from EMA alignment. Confirmed against the real HERMES source (signal_builder.py's _determine_regime()), not invented.

fields.name: session
fields.description: HERMES-computed named trading session (london/newyork/asia/overlap_ldn_ny/off_hours), confirmed against the real HERMES source (utils/trading_hours.py's get_current_session() and utils/hermes_sessions_v1.py's SESSION_NAMES). Deliberately distinct from ares.market_status.session_state's session_id/session_state (ARES session LIFECYCLE state -- PRE_OPEN/OPEN/CLOSING/CLOSED/HOLIDAY -- is a different concept from this geographic/named session, per PID-05's own discovery-phase finding; the two must never be conflated despite the shared word 'session').

fields.name: signal_type
fields.description: Free-text classification/name for a hermes.signal_state event (e.g. a specific detected condition or signal shape). No enum is imposed: unlike regime/session, this delivery has no evidenced, closed HERMES-side value set to cite, and would rather leave it open than fabricate one.

fields.name: signal_natural_key
fields.description: The one required identity anchor for hermes.signal_state: a producer-constructed string representing HERMES own real natural key (instrument:timeframe:produced_at_utc). This is NOT a claim that HERMES has a stable independent event id -- PID-05 Section 9/D.6 already established it does not (its SQL (instrument, timeframe, timestamp) key is an upsert key, not an event identity). signal_natural_key is deliberately just an honest string representation of that same real, already-existing natural key, required so the payload carries at least one concrete anchor -- the eventual deterministic falcon_event_id derivation (UUID5, per D.6) is expected to be computed FROM this same natural key at publish time, not from a separately invented identity.
